title: Evidence-First Multi-Model Compounding Loop

stages.input: exact source locator or direct user request
stages.rule: Preserve provenance, observation time, scope, client route, and uncertainty. A capture is not canonical truth.

stages.output: verified observation, contradiction, or explicit unavailable finding
stages.rule: Check authority, directness, freshness, scope, and conflicting evidence. Do not allow the maker to self-certify consequential work.

stages.output: proposed update to the strongest existing canonical owner
stages.rule: Update before duplicating. Preserve source references, freshness, limits, and contradictions. No worker writes canonical state.

stages.input: current canonical model plus verified evidence
stages.output: bounded action, experiment, human gate, or deliberate no-op
stages.rule: State the hypothesis, baseline, expected outcome, acceptance test, checker, rollback, and approval boundary.

stages.input: validated scope and targeted context slice
stages.rule: Use the resolved task lane and live-ready route. Never infer external-action authority from tool or account access.

stages.input: actual artifact, test, rendered surface, or live readback
stages.output: measured result against the predeclared acceptance test
stages.rule: File existence and model claims are not outcomes. Inspect the actual output and record pass, fail, mixed, or inconclusive.

stages.input: verified result plus user decision or observed outcome
stages.output: at most one canonical correction, precedent, workflow change, or explicit non-finding
stages.rule: Retain only demonstrated reusable learning. Preserve history, never store secrets, and do not let the brain become a second operational queue.

failurePolicy: No live-ready route means blocked, not guessed execution.
No independent checker means consequential completion cannot be claimed.
A stale or ambiguous source remains capture or research candidate.
A client or account ambiguity fails closed before any worker receives context.
A provider, quota, authentication, or human-interaction gate is surfaced without bypass.
A failed experiment restores only its own reversible changes and retains the evidence receipt.
